method.building_objects: clip GABLE VHR footprints to provisional key areas and classify each object with Chapter 04 renewal readings
method.project_assignment: assign each building once to the nearest project centre when it falls inside overlapping conceptual implementation envelopes
method.capacity: assigned existing GABLE capacity proxy multiplied by transparent project-specific conditional increment ratios
method.node_depth: three conceptual node envelopes plus schematic interface links and visible section-control sequences

limitations: All key-area and project envelopes are provisional design geometry, not official redlines or parcels.
GABLE footprints and heights are VHR-derived proxies, not surveyed buildings or legal property records.
Capacity bands are scheme controls, not statutory FAR, approved construction quantities, engineering quantities, or investment commitments.
Conditional rebuild candidates are survey priorities, not confirmed demolition decisions.
Recompute all outputs when official GIS/CAD, planning controls, building survey, ownership, heritage, traffic, and engineering data arrive.
